name: Bossard Holding AG
summary: Bossard Holding AG engages in the provision of industrial fastening and assembly solutions in Europe, the United States, and Asia. It offers standard fastening elements, such as screws, nuts, washers, pins, clamping and positioning elements, and anchorage systems; direct assembly screws for wood, metal, plastics, and masonry; and securing and anti-loosening elements, including securing and anti-loosening screws and washers, self-locking nuts, and retaining rings for shafts and bores.
